ModMetaData.name: More Baby Food Recipes
ModMetaData.author: lyj
ModMetaData.description:
Adds raw meat to the ingredients accepted by the vanilla baby food and bulk baby food recipes. Everything else, including workbenches, yield, stats, and graphics, remains unchanged.
为原版婴儿食品和批量制作婴儿食品配方加入生肉原料。制作地点、产量、属性和贴图等其他内容保持原版设定。
